title: Sample — Al Safa Café Pavilion (Area Demo)
description: Small zone/space breakdown showing the area rollup. Delete this file's content and build your own — nothing here is required by the schema.

children.label: Café Pavilion
children.description: Top-level zone. Its area line will show the auto-summed total of every space below it that has an area set.

children.label: Indoor Seating
children.description: Leaf space with an explicit area.

children.label: Kitchen
children.description: Leaf space with an explicit area.

children.label: Storage
children.description: No area set on purpose — since its siblings (Indoor Seating, Kitchen) have area, this one will render a small 'no area set' warning you can click to fill in.

children.label: Outdoor Terrace
children.description: A second zone with nested sub-spaces, to show a two-level sum.

children.label: Dining Terrace
children.description: This node has children, so it never stores its own area — it derives it from its two leaves below.

children.label: Planter Strip
children.description: Leaf, no area — kept empty deliberately since its sibling (Dining Terrace) does end up with a derived area, so this one gets the warning too.

children.label: Back of House
children.description: No area anywhere in this branch — behaves exactly like a process with no area feature in use at all. No warnings, no Σ line.
